department and fee are shown only on the doctors list and the doctor page

findings.text: REQ-7 covers both specialization and department in one REQ, while REQ-1 and REQ-2 are split per field; splitting keeps one behaviour per REQ.

rubric_items.reason: All six acceptance criteria map to REQ-1..REQ-11; AC5 split into REQ-9/REQ-10; out-of-scope items carry reasons.
REQs are checkable; REQ-7 bundles specialization and department while REQ-1/REQ-2 split them per field.
Every known REQ cites the ticket, baseline or data model; REQ-7 cites the user's answer A-01 with a recorded mismatch.
Inactive reference list case was asked (A-01). C7 (closed appointments never change) is claimed but its relation to REQ-5 current details is not discussed.
Q-02 is non-blocking with real options, but is partly answered by the glossary (Paise, Inactive entries) and off the ticket's asks.
Plain and readable; glossary table marks Consultation fee not found though Paise covers fee storage.
